mentions.name: KidCareKit
mentions.description: A Rails SaaS for family-run daycare centers that wraps waitlist management, enrollments, and Stripe billing into a single dashboard. Scheduled jobs automate weekly tuition and late fee invoicing for predictable cash flow, and transactional email keeps parents informed. Current work polishes an onboarding flow to import families, configure billing cadence, and connect Stripe in under ten minutes, with occupancy and revenue analytics and a guided late fee policy setup planned next.
mentions.problem: Family-run daycare centers still juggle spreadsheets and phone calls, and owners hand-crank invoices without predictable cash flow.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building https://www.kidcarekit.com, a Rails SaaS for family-run daycare centers that still juggle spreadsheets and phone calls.
